fns.desc: wps_init(): in the CONFIG_WPS_NFC alt-password branch, data->alt_dev_password = data->dev_password (line 72) transfers the original PIN-derived buffer to alt_dev_password, then data->dev_password is reassigned via os_memdup (line 76-78). If that os_memdup fails (line 79), the function calls os_free(data) and returns NULL without ever freeing data->alt_dev_password - leaking the original PIN buffer since only the outer struct is freed, not its members.

Same root cause as the line-79 leak: if the NFC alt-password branch executed (setting data->alt_dev_password), a later os_strdup("00000000") failure in the PBC branch (line 93-96) again calls os_free(data) without freeing data->alt_dev_password. Also applies to the new_ap_settings failure path at line 125-129 (bin_clear_free frees dev_password but never alt_dev_password).
